diagrams.title: A widget remains a projection
diagrams.summary: The widget receives readable state, makes it perceptible, and returns intents without becoming the subject authority.

nodes.label: Subject state
nodes.description: The authority supplies a stable reading.

nodes.label: Widget contract
nodes.description: Data is adapted to public inputs.

nodes.label: Rendering
nodes.description: The widget produces a perceptible representation.

nodes.label: Interaction
nodes.description: The local gesture becomes an intent.

nodes.label: External command
nodes.description: The authority decides whether to admit or reject the change.

diagrams.caption: The widget never silently modifies the canonical state it represents.
